review_evidence: Complete primary inventory covers 112 Lean files; 58 files contain 504 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

The Autoinc library formalizes change structures and differential/incremental operators, list/set/integer/natural transformations, stack-language semantics, typing, validity, traces, and correctness results.
Benchmark and example modules exercise the same incremental semantics and operators and are retained under the content-first policy; no lossless noise selector was established.
summary: Retain the complete autoinc-lean unit as a formal framework for incremental computation and its checked examples/benchmarks.
